author: ai
text: The G20 was founded in 1999, when finance ministers and central bank governors first met under that name. It had 20 members in 1999: 19 countries and the European Union. Leaders held the first G20 summit in 2008. The African Union became a member in 2023. The G20 had 21 members in 2026: 19 countries, the European Union and the African Union.
